preferences.title: How do you want to see this site?
preferences.anim_desc_fluid: Smooth morphs, wave staggers, soft easing

hero.claim: A formal methodology for governing software ecosystems where AI agents write production code. A system of rules, mechanical hooks, specialized agents and audits that ensure coherence, security and traceability when AI co-authors the code.
hero.sub1: It's not a framework. It's not a tool. It's a system of constraints, mechanical hooks, and verification protocols that transforms human-AI collaboration from improvisation into engineering.
hero.sub2: Designed by Fabio Cherici and tested on over one million lines of production code. Now being formalized as an open protocol.

problem.title: The problem
problem.p1: In 2026 anyone can generate code with AI. Speed is no longer an advantage — it's a commodity.
problem.p2: The problem is what happens next. Code generated without constraints produces technical debt at the same speed it produces features. No documentation. No consistency across projects. No guarantee that today's code won't break tomorrow's.
problem.p3: This is called vibe coding. It's fast. And it doesn't scale.

produces.title: What Oracode produces
produces.intro: Oracode doesn't slow AI down. It constrains it.
produces.stats: 13 blocking P0 rules. 20 mechanical hooks that intervene before every write. 8 specialized agents. A 4-level priority system that distinguishes what breaks the system from what can wait.
produces.result_gdpr: Every project is born GDPR-compliant by design — audit trail, consent management, data export, right to erasure
produces.result_i18n: Every interface is born in 6 languages — Italian, English, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese
produces.result_errors: Every error goes through a unified handler — not a forgotten log, a structured response
produces.result_trace: Every file is signed, dated, traceable back to the decision that generated it
produces.closing: This isn't quality added after the fact. It's quality that cannot be removed.

organism.title: The frontier: software organisms
organism.p1: A project built with Oracode can become something no framework produces: a software organism that knows itself.
organism.p2: 149 SSOT documents automatically synchronized with the code. Every code change updates the corresponding documentation — not through human willpower, but through a documentary nervous system (DOC-SYNC v2) that analyzes the semantic diff and applies patches.
organism.p3: This documentation is indexed into a RAG queryable via AI chat integrated into every platform. The result: the software can answer questions about itself.
organism.quote: "Which endpoints touch Egili transactions?" — An answer grounded in real documentation, not a model trained months ago.
organism.stats: 136 tracked missions. 482 watch patterns. 39% of the ecosystem under automatic documentation coverage — and growing.

proof.title: The proof
proof.numbers: 1,002,558 lines of code. 9 platforms in production. 11 languages. 5,354 files. 8,686 public symbols cataloged.
proof.concurrent_desc: ~2,000 commits across 13 repositories in 48 days. One person. Simultaneously.
proof.credential_overlap: 18 days with commits on both Sigillo and Credential on the same day
proof.credential_compare: Same compliance level as Microsoft Entra Verified ID — a team of 50-100 engineers, 3+ years.
proof.gialloro_compare: Two days to build. One day for SEO, accessibility, and deploy.

protocol.title: Why a protocol
protocol.p1: These results were achieved with Oracode still under construction. Not all 20 hooks existed in March. DOC-SYNC v2 became operational in May. Every platform was both a product and a proving ground.
protocol.p2_point1: the numbers above are with an incomplete version
protocol.p2_point2: Oracode is not a theory — it's forged under load, corrected every time a missing constraint produced a real error
protocol.p3: The work in progress: transforming what today lives in 20 hooks, 13 rules, 8 agents, and 149 documents into an open, documented, replicable protocol.

closing.text: The source code, the commits, the dates, the hours: everything is public or verifiable on request.
closing.emphasis: No claim on this page exists without corresponding proof.

oracode.title: Oracode
oracode.subtitle: The paradigm
oracode.intro: A software development system with LLMs, designed for those who build to last.
oracode.pillar_1_desc: Every file declares its purpose. No code exists without a documented reason.
oracode.pillar_2_desc: No premature abstraction. Three similar lines beat a premature pattern.
oracode.pillar_3_desc: Unified terminology. One concept, one name, everywhere.
oracode.pillar_4_desc: Every bug becomes a test. Every feature becomes a pattern.
oracode.pillar_5_desc: Documentation updates automatically with the code.
oracode.pillar_6_desc: GDPR, audit trail, error handling — built in, not bolted on.
oracode.level_1_desc: One project with P0 rules, hooks, signature. Already meaningful.
oracode.level_2_desc: Mission protocol, DOC-SYNC, specialized agents. The project self-documents.
oracode.level_3_desc: Documentary nervous system. The software knows itself via RAG.
oracode.level_4_desc: An ecosystem of projects coordinated by a central brain. FlorenceEGI.
oracode.zero_rule_quote: If you don't know, ask. Never infer.
oracode.zero_rule_detail: The simplest rule and the most violated. An LLM that completes statistically invents what it doesn't know. Oracode blocks it first.

prove.title: The proof
prove.subtitle: Verifiable numbers, git log links, complete audits.
prove.proj_sigillo_what: Blockchain file certification — SHA-256 + Algorand + TSA RFC 3161
prove.proj_sigillo_integrations: Algorand, Stripe, IPFS, TSA, AI advisor
prove.proj_credential_what: W3C professional credential wallet — 11 standards (SD-JWT, OID4VCI, EdDSA, DID:web, eIDAS 2.0)
prove.proj_credential_compare: Same compliance level as Microsoft Entra Verified ID — a team of 50-100 engineers, 3+ years.
prove.proj_gialloro_what: Luxury e-commerce + headless CMS — Laravel + React + MariaDB
prove.proj_gialloro_integrations: Optimized SEO, WCAG AA, complete deploy
prove.proj_gialloro_compare: Two days to build. One day for SEO, accessibility, and deploy.
prove.methodology_p1: All hours are measured from verifiable git sessions: first commit — last commit per session, with a 15-minute pre/post tolerance.
prove.methodology_p2: Lines of code are counted with cloc on clean codebases (excluding node_modules, vendor, build artifacts).
prove.methodology_p3: Comparison data with traditional teams are conservative estimates based on public industry benchmarks for projects of equivalent complexity.

ecosistema.title: Ecosystem
ecosistema.subtitle: 9 platforms, one organism. FlorenceEGI.
ecosistema.organ_egi_desc: Creator economy, Algorand blockchain assets, shared core services (auth, payment, Egili). Host for Sigillo and future products.
ecosistema.organ_hub_desc: Single SSOT for configuration of all organs. No organ self-configures. Absolute hierarchical authority.
ecosistema.organ_hub_home_desc: World-class 3D entry point to the ecosystem. Integrates Sigillo as secondary entrypoint.
ecosistema.organ_natan_desc: RAG on Public Administration records + AI assistant for Italian municipalities. 56,000 documents, 190,000 vector chunks.
ecosistema.organ_credential_desc: Professional competencies certified on Algorand. 11 standards (SD-JWT, OID4VCI, EdDSA, DID:web, eIDAS 2.0).
ecosistema.organ_sigillo_desc: SHA-256 + Algorand + TSA RFC 3161 certification of any file. Third-party enforceable proof.
ecosistema.organ_bottega_desc: AI Maestro, 12 tools, 3 paths. Artist development as a brand + informed valuation for collectors.
ecosistema.organ_info_desc: Public informational page for FlorenceEGI. Zero backend.
ecosistema.organ_staging_desc: The creator chooses template, animation, 3D scene, subdomain. FlorenceEGI builds the site.
ecosistema.infra_p1: A single PostgreSQL database (AWS RDS) shared by all organs. Schema core.* with tables for users, wallets, Egili transactions, GDPR.
ecosistema.infra_p2: A documentary nervous system (149 SSOTs) indexed in a platform RAG queryable from every organ via AI sidebar.
ecosistema.infra_p3: An internal economic system (Egili) MiCA-safe that flows across the entire ecosystem.

meta.home_description: Oracode: a paradigm that disciplines AI to produce software that stands the test of time. Over 1 million lines of code, 9 platforms, one person.
